_readme: Read by RCG_decorations (rcg_version.lua) on start and every few hours. A server whose installed version (fxmanifest.lua) is older than 'latest' prints the newer releases in its console. 'releases' = newest first; severity = important | recommended | optional; 'why' = one line on why it matters.

releases.why: First Tebex release: preset schedules, DLC packs and fixes to preset placing.
notes: Preset schedules: presets put themselves up and take themselves away by dates and hours (game or real), with an optional sky
DLC packs: drop a pack resource next to RCG_decorations and its props show up, no config
Run, jump and climb while placing (Config.Placement.runJump)
Fixed: a preset with a reward chest could stop placing halfway and duplicate props
